help.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to use CalmBridge
flowSteps: Step 1 — Language: Choose English, Korean, French, or Swahili
Step 2 — Situation: Select what you are going through (disaster, conflict, loss, isolation, or other)
Step 3 — Spiritual comfort: Optionally choose a faith tradition for extra support
Chat: Talk with CalmBridge — it listens, validates, and gently helps you find support
featureList: WHO PFA Chatbot — AI responses follow the Look-Listen-Link framework
Spiritual Comfort — Optional texts from Christianity or Secular traditions (more traditions planned)
Voice Input — Speak instead of type using your microphone
Crisis Banner — Tap 🆘 anytime for emergency hotlines
Offline Ready — Works with limited or no internet connection
Dark / Light Mode — Toggle in the header
help.pfaDesc: CalmBridge follows the World Health Organization's Psychological First Aid framework — an evidence-based approach to support people in distress.
help.pfa_look_desc: The AI silently reads your situation and adapts its tone — calm for acute crisis, warm for grief, structured for overwhelm.
help.pfa_listen_desc: CalmBridge acknowledges your feelings before offering solutions. It never pressures you to share more than you want.
help.pfa_link_desc: When appropriate, CalmBridge gently connects you to professional help, crisis lines, or local support resources.

termList.desc: World Health Organization Psychological First Aid — an evidence-based approach to support people in distress after crises.
The three-step PFA framework: assess the situation, listen compassionately, then connect to appropriate support.
Optional tradition-specific texts (scripture, wisdom, secular reflections) to offer additional emotional grounding.
Tap the microphone icon to speak your message instead of typing. Useful when hands are occupied or typing feels hard.
Automatically activates when distress signals are detected. Provides emergency contacts and immediate support.
CalmBridge works without internet. Messages are queued and sent automatically when connectivity is restored.

help.voiceDesc: Speak your message — EN, KO, FR, SW
help.privacyDesc: No personal data is stored. Conversations are not saved on our servers. Your session is private.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: CalmBridge is a stateless application. We do not collect, store, or share any personally identifiable information (PII). No account registration is required.

sections.title: Local device storage
sections.body: CalmBridge stores only your language preference and theme setting in your browser's localStorage. This data never leaves your device.

sections.title: AI message processing
sections.body: Messages you send are processed by OpenAI's API to generate responses. We do not retain messages after the API call completes.

sections.title: Voice input
sections.body: Voice input uses your browser's built-in Web Speech API. CalmBridge does not receive or store raw audio.
